description: Conduct a comprehensive comparative study on the anatomical and behavioral differences between the Panthera genus (big cats) and small cats. Focus specifically on the roaring mechanism, retractable claw variations, nocturnal vision adaptations, hunting strategies, genetic lineage of Panthera, and the unique social structure of lions compared to other big cats.
expected_output: A professional, well-structured Markdown article synthesizing all research findings, stored in the knowledge base or reported as an error if failed.
